items.summary: Investing.com -- Bernstein has named its preferred stocks in the payments sector, citing attractive valuations, expanding growth opportunities and the potential for stronger shareholder returns, while downgrading Toast to Market-Perform.

items.title: Visa (V) Ties Monad Stablecoin Settlement Move To New Fraud API Rollout
items.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) has added the Monad blockchain to its stablecoin settlement program as a new multi-chain option. Global Payments is integrating Visa's IDX API into its Adaptive Authentication service to support identity and fraud checks for clients. Both moves signal Visa's push to expand blockchain-based settlement tools and strengthen digital transaction security for payment partners. items.title: Visa adds Monad to stablecoin settlement options
items.summary:
Scott Melker discusses Visa (V) adding Monad as yet another option for settlecoin settlements. Visa already allows settlements on ethereum (ETH-USD), Solana (SOL-USD), and Avalanche (AVAX-USD).

"The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Goldman Sachs, Citi commit millions to stablecoin venture: What to know
items.summary: Goldman Sachs, Citi, and other banks are committing $270 million to a stablecoin venture called "Project Faro." Scott Melker outlines what you need to know.

items.title: Can Visa's Monad Integration Boost Its Stablecoin Strategy?
items.summary: V expands its stablecoin settlement network with Monad, enhancing blockchain flexibility as settlement volumes surge and institutional adoption gains momentum.

items.title: Financial Select Sector SPDR (XLF) Buys $26.7 Million More Berkshire on Nov. 9
